name: Dutch Reformed churches

citations.excerpt: An indigenous type of Protestantism existed in the Netherlands before Calvinism was introduced from France and the Reformed Church was born in 1568.

facts.value: Reformed churches of Dutch heritage, including the Dutch Reformed Church of southern Africa, founded in the 17th century by Dutch settlers.

citations.locator: Dutch Reformed Church (South Africa), member profile
citations.excerpt: The Dutch Reformed Church (DRC), founded in the 17th century by Dutch settlers in southern Africa, includes more than one million members and three theological faculties.

facts.value_before_verify: Reformed churches of the Netherlands and Dutch settlement, including the Dutch Reformed Church of southern Africa, founded by 17th-century settlers.

research_notes: Family entry; South African DRC data cited as one representative. Netherlands church itself (PKN) not separately on list.
